items.title: #433 How Michael Bloomberg Works
items.description:
why this sharpens your taste:
1) Senra’s craft: compress an operator’s whole work system into transferable heuristics — Bloomberg as attention architecture, not just a product story.
2) Trains you to study HOW someone works (calendar, information diet, decision hygiene) instead of only what they built.
